zh-CN.title: 多选消息操作更完整
items: 多选消息时可批量复制文本、保存多媒体、删除或撤回消息
部分消息不适用当前操作时，会先说明实际处理数量

en.title: More complete multi-message actions
items: Multi-select now supports copying text, saving media, deleting, and recalling messages
When an action only applies to some selections, Sermo confirms the exact number first
